convert_matting_to_omnimatte: run the CLI tool to convert a matting format video folder to Omnimatte format with images, masks, flow, and homography
copy_folder_with_glob: copy files matching glob patterns from a source folder to a destination folder with optional overwrite control
prepare_homography: compute or reuse homography files from a video folder by running preprocess and third-party homography scripts
resize_and_save_images: read images from a matting folder, optionally resize to 448x256 with Lanczos resampling, and save as optimized PNG
copy_masks_and_flow: copy mask folders and optical flow files including .flo flow and confidence PNG files to the output directory
